name: @swarmmachina/swm-logs
description: Zero-dependency structured JSON logger for Node.js
author: SwarmMachina Team

scripts.check: prettier . --check && eslint . && tsc --project tsconfig.json && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json
scripts.bench: pnpm build && pnpm build:benchmark && node benchmark/bench.js --scenario all --runs 3 --warmup 1
scripts.bench:b1: pnpm build && pnpm build:benchmark && node benchmark/bench.js --scenario b1 --runs 3 --warmup 1
scripts.bench:b2: pnpm build && pnpm build:benchmark && node benchmark/bench.js --scenario b2 --runs 3 --warmup 1
scripts.bench:b3: pnpm build && pnpm build:benchmark && node benchmark/bench.js --scenario b3 --runs 3 --warmup 1
scripts.bench:b4: pnpm build && pnpm build:benchmark && node benchmark/bench.js --scenario b4 --runs 3 --warmup 1
scripts.bench:b5: pnpm build && pnpm build:benchmark && node benchmark/bench.js --scenario b5 --runs 3 --warmup 1
scripts.bench:b6: pnpm build && pnpm build:benchmark && node benchmark/bench.js --scenario b6 --runs 3 --warmup 1
scripts.bench:b7: pnpm build && pnpm build:benchmark && node benchmark/bench.js --scenario b7 --runs 3 --warmup 1
scripts.profile:ci: pnpm build && pnpm build:benchmark && node benchmark/profile-ci.js
scripts.profile:compare: pnpm build && pnpm build:benchmark && node benchmark/profile-compare.js
scripts.profile:extensions: pnpm build && pnpm build:benchmark && node benchmark/profile-extensions.js
scripts.release:gate: pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test:unit && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/e2e/*.test.ts && pnpm test:leak && pnpm test:types && pnpm test:package
